name: handoff_provenance_check
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys,base64
p=Path.cwd();r=json.loads((p/'reservation.json').read_text());rs=json.loads((p/'results.json').read_text());assert set(rs)==set(map(str,r['ids'])) and len(rs)==20
pr=json.loads((p/'original-provenance.json').read_text())
for k,v in pr.items():
 raw=(p/'original-lines'/(k+'.jsonl')).read_bytes();token=(p/'statement-tokens'/(k+'.json')).read_bytes();s=(p/'statements'/(k+'.txt')).read_bytes()
 assert raw==base64.b64decode(v['raw_base64']) and raw.endswith(b'\n') and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==v['raw_sha256']
 assert hashlib.sha256(token).hexdigest()==v['statement_token_sha256'] and hashlib.sha256(s).hexdigest()==v['decoded_sha256']
 assert json.loads(token)==s.decode() and json.loads(raw)['statement']==s.decode()
receipts=[]
for f in sorted(p.glob('*.receipt.json')):
 v=json.loads(f.read_text());assert v['exit']==0 and v['killed'] is None
 receipts.append({'path':f.name,'exit':v['exit'],'wall_s':v['wall_s'],'cpu_s':v['child_cpu_cumulative_s'],'sampled_rss_bytes':v['sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes'],'affinity':v['affinity']})
q={'exact_twenty':True,'raw_token_utf8_bindings_verified':20,'reservation_sha256':hashlib.sha256((p/'reservation.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'receipts':receipts,'scope':'Documentary provenance/resource check only, not mathematical or independent scientific validation. This invocation and terminal manifest receipts are finalized after this inventory.'}
assert q['reservation_sha256']=='4a280464f285a27b0c74a52bcb85ef0b9539dbe8d3d555ea66a96d8b94046180'
z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'handoff-check.json'],input=json.dumps(q,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
print('20 raw/token/UTF8 bindings verified;',len(receipts),'completed successful receipts. No independent mathematics claim.')
